description.text: An elite Landbreaker brute enhanced by fumes known as hazefyre. This particular LB is a towering giant armed with a great axe. Such elites are usually seen leading Bonekrusher raiding mobs.
His grab attack deals massive DMG. If an operator is grabbed, use another operator's skill to interrupt him and free the grabbed operator.
Dodging the charged double axe swings will not be easy. Try to interrupt him instead.
